actions.queryOrUrl: Kyoto Japan cafe restaurant official menu cappuccino draft beer price
actions.outcome: Search returned the official SHAVA LIVA bar menu with draft and bottled beer prices and a KAFE INARI official menu snippet listing a hot cappuccino for JPY 550, tax included. Selected SHAVA LIVA for the required open because its direct page specifies draft beer.

Opened SHAVA LIVA's official bar page at the Kyoto City Hall/Kawaramachi Oike corner. It lists Asahi Super Dry draft beer JPY 600 tax included, Heineken bottled beer JPY 700, and Asahi Premium bottled beer JPY 750; serving sizes are unstated. The opened page has no cappuccino or food prices.

actions.queryOrUrl: Kyoto official 3 star hotel booking November 17 20 2026 two adults nightly rate
actions.outcome: Search found an official Kyoto Tower Hotel Annex availability calendar with isolated JPY 34,200 entries on Nov 18 and 20 but no displayed rate on Nov 17 or 19. A separate official three-star listing showed no prices; selected the official Hotel Annex site for the required open.

Opened the official Kyoto Tower Hotel Annex site. It describes rooms for two or three guests and a location three minutes from Kyoto Station, but the page text does not establish a star class or show dated rates, occupancy, room type or taxes. The search-result calendar showed only scattered dated rates, not the requested stay.

actions.queryOrUrl: Kyoto official museum adult admission ticket price 2026 museum
actions.outcome: Search returned the Kyoto National Museum official admission page with a current adult special-exhibition price; selected this official source for the required open.

Opened the Kyoto National Museum official page. The Tale of Genji special exhibition runs Oct 6-Nov 29, 2026 with adult same-day admission JPY 2,200. Collection exhibitions are not on view during special exhibitions, and the page lists no ordinary collection admission for Nov 17-20.
